name: FULL-METAL LILIES
source:
An amnesiac android has only five days to piece together her former life, before she must fight in the galaxy’s most widely-consumed mecha tournament.

And now you have three headaches to deal with.

The girl from your parent corporation, whose purview over you is strictly professional even if her feelings clearly aren’t. 
The girl who took you out of commission brutally, but who won’t stop sliding into your private messages. 
The girl who may or may not be living in the walls, gatecrashing the tournament for her own reasons. 

[From [url=https://arcees.itch.io/full-metal-lilies]itch.io[/url]]
